views.markdown: An **unofficial fork** of [34306/mineland](https://github.com/34306/mineland). It adds an off-by-default, version-aware MobileGestalt activation switch while retaining mineland's positioning, visibility, rotation, and transparency controls.
Original project by **34306**. Original positioning code credited by the project to **KhanhDuyTran**. This fork adds the rootless Dynamic Island activation manager and settings integration.

On iOS 18 and later, activation uses the MobileGestalt `CacheExtra` capability flag. On iOS 17 and earlier, users can select a 2556-pixel (6.1-inch) or 2796-pixel (6.7-inch) `ArtworkDeviceSubType` layout. Disabling the switch restores the original value. A userspace reboot may be required.

### 2.3.3

- Added iOS 17-and-earlier Dynamic Island activation using `ArtworkDeviceSubType`.
- Added selectable 2556-pixel and 2796-pixel layouts with model guidance.
- Kept the iOS 18-and-later MobileGestalt capability method.
- Restores the original MobileGestalt value when activation is disabled.

### 2.2.2

- Added an off-by-default Dynamic Island activation switch.
- Added a root daemon that applies and restores the MobileGestalt capability.
- Added rootless launchctl path detection.
- Kept the original mineland positioning and appearance controls.
